name: Pets of the Homeless
description: Free pet food locations and emergency vet care funding for people experiencing homelessness
fullDescription: Pets of the Homeless (Feeding Pets of the Homeless) is a nonprofit that helps people experiencing homelessness care for their pets with free pet food and emergency veterinary care.
whatTheyOffer:
- Map of pet food and supply providers, pet-friendly shelters, and other resources
- Emergency veterinary care funding for sick or injured pets, paid directly to the vet
- Limit of 3 pets per owner; does not cover routine wellness, vaccines, or spay/neuter (unless required for housing)
- Cannot pay past bills or reimburse treatment already provided
howToGetIt:
1. Visit petsofthehomeless.org and use the location finder for food and supplies near you (call providers first to confirm supplies)
2. For emergency vet care, submit the online application
3. Have a social worker, shelter staff, outreach worker, or similar contact verify your living situation
4. Applications are reviewed in order received, Monday-Friday 8 am-4 pm Pacific
keywords: Pets of the Homeless, homeless pet help, free vet care, free pet food, emergency pet, street pet, unhoused, pet assistance
